component.name: Universe Workstation
寰宇工作台
component.summary: Zero-cloud mTLS 1.3 LAN clipboard sync and file sharing between Linux and Android
基于双向 mTLS 1.3 的 Linux 与 Android 局域网安全互联工具

description.p: Universe Workstation connects Linux desktops and rooted Android devices over your local network with Ed25519 signed discovery, 6-digit SAS pairing, pinned TLS 1.3 mutual authentication, lossless text and image clipboard sync, and BLAKE3-verified streaming file transfers.
Universe Workstation 1.0 Ant initial public release.
